plain_summary: Review rivaroxaban effectiveness during concurrent carbamazepine treatment.
rule_for_models: Review concurrent carbamazepine and rivaroxaban. Calculate days of cover from each quantity and the stated units per day, starting on its supply date. Check for shared treatment days. Ask the patient whether they were taking both medicines together. Cite the medicine and qualifying fact or interacting supply. If a daily dose is unclear and the supplies could overlap, report only a possible finding. Ask about the doses and the dates each medicine was taken. Exclude a completed switch or other history showing that the courses did not overlap. The reason either medicine was prescribed does not exclude co-use.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish actual use, indication or a prescriber’s intent. Treatment and assessments elsewhere may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you review whether carbamazepine may reduce rivaroxaban effectiveness and whether an alternative anticoagulant or an alternative to carbamazepine would be appropriate?
